name: animated-accordion
title: Animated Accordion
description: A free React accordion that opens on a spring. The open entry lifts onto its own tile, its height eases to fit the text, the text follows a beat later and the plus turns into a minus. Single or multiple open, light or dark, with real buttons inside headings and Up, Down, Home and End to move between titles.
